title: whatsapp_inbox._link_known_customer
description: The payload of `whatsapp_inbox.message.received`, verbatim — a manifest listener has no mapping layer. Two commands emit it with different shapes (`_ingest_inbound_message`: `from`/`contact`/`direction`; `messages.ingest`: `wa_contact_id`/`contact_phone`), so nothing is required and anything is accepted: a stricter schema would not degrade the link, it would dead-letter the event for this listener. The handler resolves the contact and links nobody when it cannot.
